methods.description: Resolve exact issue subjects to pinned Atlas and geoBoundaries source features; compare names, parent membership and polygons; compute source-to-ADM1 overlaps and diagnostic flags using the shared geometry helper. No administrative truth is inferred from counts or geometric agreement.
methods.software: Python 3.12; Shapely 2.1.2; pyproj 3.8.0; scripts/evidence/geometry.py version worldatlas-evidence-geometry-v1
methods.units: counts and ratios; WGS84 EPSG:4326 longitude-latitude polygons; ellipsoidal land area in m²; IoU is dimensionless
methods.area_method: WGS84 ellipsoidal area through scripts/evidence/geometry.py canonical_land and land_area_m2

conclusions.text: The source layer is district-like and all 228 names/IDs align structurally, but no same-vintage authoritative row roster or legal boundary crosswalk is available; legal status and exact parent/boundary remain unresolved for each row.
The 973 raw source feature count differs from its metadata declaration of 999 and cannot be reconciled from arithmetic against TurkStat’s count.
HGM’s described vectors are indicative and current; they do not establish 2021 legal boundaries.
